        SELECT o2.customer_id, o2.customer_segment, SUM(o3.order_total) AS cust_total

    ) s
    WHERE s.customer_segment = (
        SELECT c.customer_segment FROM blinkit_customers c WHERE c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    )
)

cases.first_sql:
WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT o.delivery_partner_id,
           COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.delivery_status = 'On Time') AS on_time_orders
    FROM blinkit_orders o
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date::date) = 2023
    GROUP BY o.delivery_partner_id
),
rates AS (
    SELECT delivery_partner_id,
           on_time_orders::double precision / total_orders AS on_time_ratio
    FROM order_counts
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT delivery_partner_id,
           on_time_ratio,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY on_time_ratio DESC) AS rnk
    FROM rates
)
SELECT delivery_partner_id
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY delivery_partner_id;
cases.final_sql:
WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT dp.delivery_partner_id,
           COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dp.delivery_status = 'On Time') AS on_time_orders
    FROM blinkit_delivery_performance dp
    JOIN blinkit_orders o ON dp.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date::date) = 2023
    GROUP BY dp.delivery_partner_id
),
rates AS (
    SELECT delivery_partner_id,
           COALESCE(on_time_orders, 0)::double precision / NULLIF(total_orders, 0) AS on_time_ratio
    FROM order_counts
    WHERE total_orders > 0
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT delivery_partner_id,
           on_time_ratio,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY on_time_ratio DESC) AS rnk
    FROM rates
)

FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY delivery_partner_id;

FROM blinkit_products p

        GROUP BY i2.product_id, p2.category
    ) AS cat_ratios
    WHERE cat_ratios.category = p.category

cases.first_sql:
WITH damage AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(CAST(damaged_stock AS numeric)) AS total_damaged, SUM(CAST(stock_received AS numeric)) AS total_received
  FROM blinkit_inventory
  GROUP BY product_id
), product_damage AS (
  SELECT p.brand, p.product_id, p.shelf_life_days,
         d.total_damaged::numeric / (d.total_damaged + d.total_received)::numeric AS damage_rate
  FROM blinkit_products p
  JOIN damage d ON p.product_id = d.product_id
  WHERE d.total_damaged + d.total_received > 0
), filtered AS (
  SELECT brand, product_id, shelf_life_days
  FROM product_damage
  WHERE damage_rate > 0.05
), brand_agg AS (
  SELECT brand, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS product_count, AVG(shelf_life_days) AS avg_shelf_life
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY brand
), ranked AS (
  SELECT brand, product_count, avg_shelf_life,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_shelf_life DESC) AS rnk
  FROM brand_agg
)
SELECT brand, product_count, avg_shelf_life
FROM ranked
ORDER BY avg_shelf_life DESC, brand ASC;

cases.first_sql:
WITH cash_item AS (
    SELECT oi.product_id, p.brand, COUNT(*) AS occurrence_count, SUM(oi.quantity) AS quantity_sum
    FROM blinkit_order_items oi
    JOIN blinkit_orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN blinkit_products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.payment_method = 'Cash'
    GROUP BY oi.product_id, p.brand
), brand_contribution AS (
    SELECT brand, SUM(occurrence_count * quantity_sum) AS sales_contribution
    FROM cash_item
    GROUP BY brand
), total AS (
    SELECT SUM(sales_contribution) AS total_contribution
    FROM brand_contribution
)
SELECT b.brand, b.sales_contribution::numeric / NULLIF(t.total_contribution::numeric, 0) AS sales_ratio
FROM brand_contribution b
CROSS JOIN total t
ORDER BY b.brand;
